# Google TV Streamer

Control Google TV Streamer media through Google Cast or remote keys and app links through Android TV Remote v2 using Muse Home Link; not a generic Google TV device skill. The Cast part delegates to the companion gadget-google-cast skill, while Remote v2 is described in this profile itself and uses a compatible androidtvremote2 client, the normal on-screen pairing code and a securely retained client certificate/private key.
